title: Questions 176-180 refer to the following e-mails.
passage_1:
To:Elena Sorokin <sorokin@calderwoodanalytics.com>
From:Ravi Chandran <r.chandran@calderwoodanalytics.com>
Date:3 September
Subject:This month

Dear Ms. Sorokin,

I just wanted to update you that things are moving forward with my transfer to the Dublin branch. My last day at this office will be 12 September. Until then, I will be completing the files for the Orion review so that the handover goes smoothly. I have also written a full guide setting out the duties of my position. It will be uploaded to the shared drive by this Thursday.

Also, please remember that I am meeting a representative of Brightwater Foods for lunch on 10 September. I would strongly suggest that my successor come with me, as he will be taking on this client’s account.

Best regards,
Ravi Chandran

To:Daniel Achebe <achebe@calderwoodanalytics.com>
From:Elena Sorokin <sorokin@calderwoodanalytics.com>
Date:4 September
Subject:Congratulations

Dear Mr. Achebe,

Congratulations on your appointment as senior analysis lead. Along with a rise in salary, you will be given a parking space at the head office and membership of the staff fitness club.

Your official first day in the new position is the day straight after Mr. Chandran’s departure. However, as I mentioned when we spoke earlier, I would like you to get in touch with him today about 10 September.

Sincerely,
Elena Sorokin
Regional Director
